meta.name: project-architecture
meta.description: The master reference for how this project is structured — services, domains, database, and the rules for how services talk to each other. Consult this before creating any new service, folder, endpoint, or cross-service call. Any agent starting a new feature that might touch more than one service should read this first.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 理清项目全局结构与服务协作规则
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要在多服务协作的项目里开发新功能,却还没看清全局。
copy.tagline_en: Understand project-wide structure and service collaboration rules
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to build new features in a multi-service project but haven't seen the full picture yet.

howto.what: Claude 会先读懂这份项目架构总览,按其中规定的服务划分、域名分工、数据库归属和“服务间只走 HTTP”等规则来指导后续开发,并在改动涉及架构时主动校验是否违反约定。
howto.when: 当你要新建服务、文件夹、端点,或发起跨服务调用,或开始可能牵连多个服务的功能时,Claude 会先查阅这份架构说明。

say.text: 我要新增一个服务,先读架构文档再给方案
say.note: Claude 会按架构约定检查服务划分和必需文件

say.text: 这个功能要跨服务调用,请先核对通信规则
say.note: 它只会建议走 HTTP + 环境变量

say.text: 新建一个 API 端点前,请先确认架构约束

howto.what_en: Claude first reads this project-architecture overview, then follows its rules on service split, domain roles, database ownership, and HTTP-only inter-service communication when planning development. It also checks whether a planned change violates these conventions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you start creating a new service, folder, endpoint, cross-service call, or any feature that may touch more than one service.

say_en.text: I want to add a new service — first read the architecture doc, then propose.
say_en.note: It checks service split and required files.

say_en.text: This feature needs cross-service calls — verify the communication rules first.
say_en.note: It only suggests HTTP + env vars.

say_en.text: Before creating a new API endpoint, confirm the architecture constraints.
say_en.note: Ensures the project structure is respected.
